conditions: This method is available from Vungle Android SDK 6.7.0
effects: Allows publishers to comply with CCPA by setting the user's CCPA status
The user's CCPA status is undefined until this method is called to set it.
In accordance with CCPA, the consent status is opted in by default unless this method has been explicitly called to set it as opted out.

conditions: To set the user's CCPA status to opted in
effects: User is opted in to being tracked in accordance with CCPA

conditions: To set the user's CCPA status to opted out
effects: User is NOT opted in to being tracked in accordance with CCPA
